scope: Other-profit sensitivity only; no base forecast replacement and no changes to frozen/root files. Record before computing valuation controls.

basis.lower_controls: Rounded 0.4B Mobileye FY2026 adjusted profit midpoint plus annualized YTD non-Mobileye proxy of 0.205–0.229B after alternative RSU-grant mapping. Not a forecast probability interval.
basis.upper_control: Rounded 0.4B Mobileye midpoint plus Q3 non-Mobileye proxy annualized around 0.36B.
basis.scope_limit: Mobileye explicitly says Intel segment reporting can differ for overhead and materiality. These proxies cannot isolate IMS exactly. Current aggregate Other profit offers stronger matched-scope anchoring than the decomposition.

treatment.years_2027_2030: Replace only the 0.7B aggregate Other operating-profit budget; all revenue, capital, financing and minority reserves unchanged.
treatment.years_2031plus: Grow profit difference at existing 3% nominal convention; keep terminal rate and discount rate unchanged.
treatment.tax: Recompute positive-EBIT ordinary operating taxes using each existing annual rate.
treatment.cash: Difference in 2027–30 after-tax operating cash changes 2030 economic cash once; no cash-income feedback, financing draw, grant duplication or additional SBC deduction.
treatment.limits: Partial profit sensitivity, not a full subsidiary operating model or statistically identified bound. Holding minority reserves fixed is conservative if their claims would fall with profit.
